name: The Freecam
pages: Players can toggle the {b}freecam{/} by pressing {k:freecam.toggle/k}. This allows the player to stop controlling their character and enter the perspective of a third-person flying camera.{pb}This tool allows players to move like in {b}spectator mode{/}, viewing builds from different perspectives. Players in freecam can't interact with their surroundings.
